regions.contentLimits: One page header plus eleven h2 sections: the break evidence, nature on a screen, sound, color, motion, first impressions, the supporting photograph evidence, the missing animation trial, the moderators, the design rules, and the claim boundary.
regions.overflow: Prose reflows. The route carries no table, no code block, and no media.

regions.contentLimits: Hand-authored h2 headings, paragraphs, one unordered list of studies, and one ordered list of design rules.
regions.overflow: No horizontal overflow is possible; the ordered list wraps within the reading measure.

responsive.compact: Single column at the full card width.
responsive.wide: Content is capped at the reading measure and centered.

focus.onError: Not applicable; the route is static and reads no data source.

accessibility.headings: One h1 for the route, then eleven h2 sections in reading order, interface evidence before photo-presence evidence. No h3.
accessibility.labels: Every link has visible text that names its destination. Both canonical records open in a new tab and say so through the link text.
